transcript.message: Hi, I saw the ad. How much is this project?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: Based on the listed package, prices are indicatively from around RM302k after the 8% rebate, depending on the unit and car-park configuration. The latest exact price and package validity need confirmation. Phase 1 units are 900 sq ft with 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. Is this mainly for your own stay or investment?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Own stay, for me and my wife. Is the RM302k price before or after the rebate? And roughly how much would the monthly instalment be?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: The RM302k is an indicative price after the 8% rebate in the listed package, not the pre-rebate price. The exact figure depends on the unit and car-park configuration, and the latest package validity needs confirmation. The monthly instalment depends on your loan amount, tenure and bank rate, so I’d need those to give a useful estimate. Are you planning to use a bank loan, and what tenure are you considering?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Probably bank loan, but I’m not sure about the tenure yet. We’re trying to keep the monthly commitment manageable—our comfortable budget is around RM3xxk. Could you give a rough idea based on that?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: If you mean a purchase price in the RM3xxk range, a rough example is about RM1,200/month for a RM302k unit on a 90% loan over 35 years, or about RM1,300 over 30 years. Near RM399k, it could be roughly RM1,590–RM1,715/month on the same assumptions. These are illustrative calculations using 4% p.a.; the actual bank rate, loan amount and tenure will change the figure, and this excludes other purchase costs. What monthly repayment ceiling would feel comfortable for you and your wife?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: We’d prefer to keep it around RM1.3k a month if possible. We have a young child too, so I’m also wondering whether 900 sqft would feel a bit tight for us. Is the Type A layout practical for a small family?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: Type A is 900 sq ft with 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. The layout is described as having an efficient open living/dining area and no long internal corridor; project materials say all three bedrooms can fit a queen bed. It could work for a small family, though 900 sq ft may still feel compact depending on how you use the rooms. Would the third room mainly be for your child, or would you also need it for work or guests?

transcript.speaker: customer
